keyEvents.text: Goal! Rakow Czestochowa 1, Rapid Vienna 0. Jonatan Braut Brunes (Rakow Czestochowa) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.

Goal! Rakow Czestochowa 2, Rapid Vienna 0. Lamine Diaby-Fadiga (Rakow Czestochowa) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jonatan Braut Brunes following a fast break.
Substitution, Rakow Czestochowa. Apostolos Konstantopoulos replaces Fran Tudor.
Goal! Rakow Czestochowa 3, Rapid Vienna 0. Lamine Diaby-Fadiga (Rakow Czestochowa) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Adriano with a cross.
Goal! Rakow Czestochowa 4, Rapid Vienna 0. Lamine Diaby-Fadiga (Rakow Czestochowa) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Patryk Makuch (Rakow Czestochowa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
